zh.title: 美國東岸風暴威脅亞特蘭大至波士頓感恩節航班
zh.summary: 美國東岸沿海風暴預計11月25日增強北移；恐衝擊亞特蘭大至波士頓感恩節期間航班
body: 根據 AeroTime 報導，一場強烈的美國東岸沿海風暴正威脅從亞特蘭大飛往波士頓的感恩節假期航班。這場風暴預計於 11 月 25 日在美國東南岸外海增強，並在感恩節期間持續向北移動，可能對美國東岸沿線的航空運輸造成影響。
隨著風暴系統逐漸北上，美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）表示，週三佛羅裏達州與墨西哥灣沿岸地區可能出現雷雨天氣。同時，Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport（ATL）也有機會出現降雨，顯示東南部主要航空樞紐在假期初期即可能面臨天候變化。
在中大西洋地區，紐澤西州 Mount Holly 的氣象預報人員指出，費城國際機場（PHL）及該地區其他機場可能出現高達每小時 65 英里的強陣風。隨著這場沿海風暴在感恩節期間沿著東岸北移，強風天氣預料將為當地機場運作帶來考驗。
在紐約都會區方面，紐華克自由機場（EWR）、甘迺迪機場（JFK）與拉瓜迪亞機場（LGA）的感恩節航空氣象預報顯示，當地將出現降雨及接近每小時 50 英里的東風陣風。此外，預報也指出上述三座紐約地區機場仍有可能出現更高的陣風峯值以及低空風切。
這場沿海風暴恰逢美國航空業年度最繁忙的旅運高峯之一。根據美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）預估，在為期九天的感恩節假期期間，全美航班總數將超過 417,000 架次，預計將成為美國航空交通近 16 年來最繁忙的感恩節假期。

en.title: Major US East Coast storm threatens Thanksgiving flights from Atlanta to Boston
en.summary: US East Coast storm threatens Thanksgiving flights from Atlanta to Boston; FAA expects over 417,000 flights.
body: A major US East Coast coastal storm is threatening Thanksgiving holiday flights from Atlanta to Boston, according to AeroTime. The weather system is expected to strengthen off the US Southeast coast on November 25 and move northward through the Thanksgiving holiday, raising the prospect of weather-related travel disruptions along the East Coast corridor.

Ahead of the storm's northward track, the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) said thunderstorms could affect Florida and the Gulf Coast on Wednesday. The agency also noted that rain is possible at Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport (ATL) as the system begins to impact air travel in the Southeast before moving north.

In the Mid-Atlantic region, forecasters in Mount Holly, New Jersey, said wind gusts as high as 65 mph are possible at Philadelphia International Airport (PHL) and other airports in the surrounding area. Such strong winds could affect airport operations as the coastal storm moves up the Eastern Seaboard during the holiday period.

Farther north in the New York metropolitan area, the Thanksgiving aviation outlook for Newark Liberty (EWR), John F. Kennedy (JFK), and LaGuardia (LGA) calls for rain and easterly gusts of near 50 mph. Forecasters also indicated that higher wind peaks and low-level wind shear are possible at the three New York-area airports.

The storm system coincides with one of the busiest travel periods of the year for US aviation. The FAA expects more than 417,000 flights nationwide over the nine-day Thanksgiving holiday period, which the agency projects will be the busiest Thanksgiving for US air traffic in 16 years.
